newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Bulletin declares 0.50 peso cash div.
newsitem.headline: Manila Bulletin declares 0.50 peso cash div.

text.p: Manila Bulletin Publishing Corp said it has declared a 0.50 peso cash dividend to stockholders on record as of September 20, 1996.
Manila Bulletin's outstanding shares numbered 762,701,400 as of September 5, 1996, a notice from the firm released by the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday said.
Early this year, the company had paid a 100 percent stock dividend. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
